paragraphs.text: Thus the wicked who do not consider that God's power is always ready to defend his, mock them as thought they were weak and feeble.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: This is the remedy that the children of God have against the derision and threatenings of their enemies, to flee to God by prayer.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Let them be spoiled and led away captive.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Let the plagues declare to the world that they set themselves against you and your Church: that he prays only having respect for God's glory and not for any private affection, or grudge.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: They who brought the tidings said this, when you leave your work, and go either to eat or to rest, your enemies will assail you.

paragraphs.text: Who is always on hand to deliver his out of danger: and therefore seeing they should fight for the maintenance of God's glory, and for the preservation of their own lives and of theirs, he encourages them to play the valiant men.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: To overcome them and encourage them in their work.
